issues.description: Return type mismatch for PersonResource.getAllPersons: the template declares getAllPersons() to return ResponseEntity<List<Person>> (and PersonService.getAll() returns List<Person>), but the solution's PersonResource declares getAllPersons() to return ResponseEntity<Set<Person>> while still returning personService.getAll() (a List). This creates a type incompatibility that will not compile and confuses students about the intended collection type for the API.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the collection type consistent across artifacts. Either change the solution's PersonResource.getAllPersons() signature to return ResponseEntity<List<Person>> (and keep returning personService.getAll()), or change the service and template to return Set<Person> consistently (update PersonService.getAll(), PersonResource, and any tests). Prefer aligning to ResponseEntity<List<Person>> to match the template and avoid compilation errors.
